---
title: Interactive Rmd
output: html_document
runtime: shiny 
---
  
```{r, echo = FALSE}
numericInput("widget_name",
"How many cars?", 5) #this is interactive widget


renderTable({
head(cars, input$widget_name) #this 'listens' to interface and responds to interactions (executes 'head' command)
})
```
